name: Investment Fund Transaction In Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of investment fund transaction that results in a cash movement into a fund.

SUBS.name: Subscription
SUBS.definition: Transaction is a subscription to an investment fund.

SWII.name: Switch In
SWII.definition: Transaction is a subscription leg of a switch order execution.

RDIV.name: Reinvestment Of Dividend
RDIV.definition: Transaction is a reinvestment of dividend.
